description: This file defines the GZIPResponseWrapper class, which extends HttpServletResponseWrapper to provide support for GZIP compression of HTTP responses. It manages output streams and writers, handles error status, and ensures proper response finalization within a web filter context.

classes.name: GZIPResponseWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletResponse that compresses output using GZIP, managing streams and writers, and handling error responses.

methods.name: GZIPResponseWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with the original HttpServletResponse.

methods.name: createOutputStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GZIPResponseStream for compressing output.

methods.name: finishResponse
methods.description: Closes streams and writers to finalize the response.

methods.name: flushBuffer
methods.description: Flushes the output stream if it exists.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Returns the ServletOutputStream, creating it if necessary, or throws if getWriter() has already been called.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the PrintWriter for writing character data, creates it if needed, or throws if getOutputStream() has already been called.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Overrides sendError to log errors and set error status.

methods.name: setContentLength
methods.description: Overrides setContentLength to do nothing, as the response is compressed and length is dynamic.
